description: A deep, thunderous, massive male voice — an ancient alien overlord and final boss. Heavy, booming, cavernous low register with vast resonance. Cold, imperious, crushing menace. Slow and deliberate, every word landing like a weight.
sample: Mankind's little fleet — so you have come this far at last. A hundred years ago I sealed your blue star behind my black fleet. You should have stayed in the dark, little ones. Now you will learn why the galaxy trembles at the name Ursa Major.
